svg.title: Dreams function review by game system
svg.desc: 56 of 9551 function names checked. 1554 functions have evidence-backed system assignments; 7997 functions do not. Sections show evidence-backed associations with parts of Dreams. Every cell is a real function. Every section is filled using the same fixed square lattice and mapped-count area scale. Labels overlay cells; there are no reserved header bands. Green means behavior or helper code reviewed; blue means property or type registration code reviewed; amber means unresolved; gray means unreviewed. Assignments are incomplete; full system totals and completion are unknown.

g.text: Counts = reviewed / identified. — = none mapped. 7,997 functions still unmapped; full system completion unknown.
